decisions.reason: The construction site dumper operates in a mature, competitive market where uncertainty has largely resolved, and without evidence of strong traction after three years the option value is low, so dropping it releases resources for more promising options.

The inclined furniture lift addresses a niche market with still-unresolved demand, and keeping it costs relatively little while the firm holds other related options, so it remains valuable as an open option.
The inclined building material lift shares platform and resource synergies with the furniture lift, lowering marginal keeping costs, so it is worth keeping while market uncertainty persists.
The truck-mounted inclined furniture lift is a more specialized variant whose demand is still uncertain, but it builds on the same core technology and can be kept at moderate cost as a real option.
